 Joe Rogan Torches ‘F**kin’ Stupid’ People Who Participate In Political Polls
 The podcaster’s take came days after Trump slammed “phony” polls.
 By   Jazmin Tolliver Trends Reporter, HuffPost
 Nov 1, 2026, 05:13 PM EST Leave a Comment LOADING ERROR LOADING Joe Rogan says he won’t be putting his trust in polls anytime soon. 
 On Saturday’s episode of the “Joe Rogan Experience,” Rogan blasted the idea of polls, arguing that only “fucking stupid” people with no lives agree to participate in polls. 
 Noting that he is part of the “intelligent group” that shuts down pollsters, Rogan continued, “Anybody with a life, anybody that has like a family and stuff to do, hobbies they enjoy, friends they want to hang out with, they don’t sit around answering some fucking poll.” 
 Advertisement 
 Rogan continued throwing barbs, telling his guests, comedian Francis Foster and political commentator Konstantin Kisin, “You’re literally getting the opinion [of] people so fucking stupid they answer polls.” 
 Rogan added: “That was my take on polls, always. I was like, ‘Here’s the problem with polls: Most people don’t answer polls.’ If somebody calls you up and says, ‘I’d like a few moments of your time to ask you a few questions’ — fuck you!” 
 Rogan’s take on polls came just days after President Donald Trump mocked the numerous negative polls about himself and his plummeting approval rating. During a campaign rally in South Carolina on Oct. 29, Trump dismissed polls as “phony” and “fake,” and blasted Wedgewood Polls after they admitted last month to using fabricated data in its surveys. 
 Advertisement 
 That poll may have been fraudulent, but Trump’s approval rating correctly sits at a meager 37% days before the pivotal midterm elections, according to a new real poll released by Emerson College on Friday.
